tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Ariake Cuttailed Bullhead adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the simplified nonhumanoid animal prop; no human hands/arms/legs/eyebrows/lips or new large eyes. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 PRESENT_RIGHT: Indicate viewer RIGHT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly rightward teaching gesture, preserve asymmetric markings, no mirrored copy. Species constraints: 人の腕・脚を追加しない。ヒゲ・斑・横帯・背鰭・尾の二叉形や非対称形を各原画どおり保つ。地面・水面・泡を追加しない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL DIRECTION: The whole fish MUST now naturally FACE VIEWER RIGHT: snout and dot eye at image right, caudal tail at image left, existing fins reprojected consistently. It must be unmistakably a right-facing full-body pose, not a left-facing fish with a moved fin. Fresh drawing, never flip pixels. Preserve eight short barbels and the few broad patches.
